name: Toolkits
description: Settings for the swappable capability toolkits — web search, extraction, crawling, browser and computer control. WHICH provider serves a toolkit is chosen in the node selector's Toolkits section; this app owns the settings that apply whichever provider is selected. Each field writes `layer.<capability>.default.<argument>`, which the capability tool facade merges underneath every call to that toolkit's verbs (an argument the caller supplies always wins). Only arguments a provider actually forwards get a field here: `web.extract`'s `format` is deliberately absent because `scrapling` is the only shipped extract provider that forwards it (onto its `extraction_type`) and the other four drop it, so a node-wide default that applies whichever provider is selected would be silently ignored by most of them.

fields.label: Search results per query
fields.description: How many results a web search returns when the agent does not ask for a specific number. Applies to whichever search provider is selected. Leave blank for the provider's own default.

fields.label: Crawl depth
fields.description: How many link hops a crawl follows from the start URL when the agent does not specify. 0 crawls only the start page.

fields.label: Crawl page limit
fields.description: Maximum pages a single crawl may fetch when the agent does not specify. The main guard against an accidental large crawl.

permission_levels.label: Can view toolkits
permission_levels.description: See which providers are bound for search, extraction, crawling and browsing.

permission_levels.label: Can change toolkits
permission_levels.description: Swap the provider behind a capability for everyone on this node.
